files_reviewed: other API routes under src/app/api/sessions, compare, me, share-card (listed, not read)
note: A personality-test site that scores a person's coding agent. Next.js and Supabase. The model is not called by this app, so no ai_* labels. The service-role key is read only in server code (src/lib/supabase/server.ts). Migration 003 removes the first public session policies and replaces them with owner-only policies, so the open policies in migration 001 are superseded for the session tables.

labels.what: A session with no owner can be changed by any caller who has its session id. Anyone who learns the UUID can submit answers or re-score (by design: anonymous-first). Owned sessions are checked at lines 41-49

compare_sets and compare_set_items keep public select and insert policies (using true, with check true). Anyone with the anon key can read every compare set and insert rows directly, and migration 003 does not drop these

Migration 001 creates open anon select, insert and update policies on test_sessions, session_answers, session_results, share_cards, instruction_runs and event_log. Migration 003 drops them, but a fresh database must run all three in order or the data stays open
Anonymous POST writes to event_log with no rate limit and free-form eventPayload (any JSON). The error branch returns the raw error message (lines 28-31)
Anonymous POST creates a session and a seeded question set per call with no rate limit; errors return the raw message (getErrorMessage in src/lib/server/http.ts lines 16-30)
Funnel analytics endpoint has no login and is publicly cacheable. Aggregates only, so low risk

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are browser-exposed by design. The service-role key is in the server schema only (lines 11-13) and no client file imports src/lib/supabase/server.ts. No secret value read
Word filter list and replacements hardcoded in code
Smoke test base URL falls back to http://localhost:3000 (same in scripts/perf-critical-routes.mjs line 16)
